newsitem.title: DUBAI: SOCCER-THAI COACH QUITS OVER ASIAN CUP FAILURE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-THAI COACH QUITS OVER ASIAN CUP FAILURE.

text.p: Thailand's soccer coach Thavatcha Sajakul has announced that he will resign following his team's poor performance in the Asian Cup.

''When we return to Bangkok the first thing I will do is to tender my resignation to the Thai Football Association,'' Sajakul was quoted by United Arab Emirates newspapers as telling a news conference on Thursday.
Thailand lost all three of their group B matches -- 6-0 to Saudi Arabia, 3-1 to Iran and 4-1 to Iraq -- to go out of the tournament.
The Thai team were expected to fly home on Friday.
